Class Pixie

java.lang.Object
Sprite
Pixie
Direct Known Subclasses:
Organism
public abstract class Pixie extends Sprite
Movable sprite with convenience constructors for life-simulation agents.

Extends Sprite with default green coloring and helpers to teleport, recolor, and offset position. Organism builds on this class to add hunger, lifespan, and AI.
